answer: VRF beacon spot-checks stop bulk fake agents. Each epoch the beacon samples a few identities; each must pass a heartbeat within minutes, proving one device runs one identity, as unique as a pearl. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 machines and answers, so cost grows linearly; a miss freezes that identity behind a basalt wall. An honest agent answers one heartbeat per epoch at almost no cost, like a wharf clearing one ship at a time, and keeps its reward undiluted.
